up: List all approved drugs and their approved indications. For each indication, include the drug name, ChEMBL ID, MeSH heading, and EFO term. Only include drugs that are approved (max_phase = 4).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.pref_name AS drug_name,
  md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id,
  di.mesh_heading,
  di.efo_term
FROM drug_indication di
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4
ORDER BY md.pref_name, di.mesh_heading;
